    int id PK

    int id PK

    int supersedes FK
  }

    text project PK
    text slug PK
    text title
    text kind "research discussion note"
    json blocks
    text text "cho FTS"
  }
  c4_meta {
    text project PK
    text name
    text root
    text layout
    json tags
  }
  c4_object {
    text project PK
    text id PK
    text type "actor system app store component group"
    text parent
  }
  c4_connection {
    text project PK
    text id PK
    text from_id
    text to_id
  }
  c4_flow {
    text project PK
    text id PK
    json steps
  }
  audit {
    int id PK
    text ts
    text actor_role
    text tool
    json before
    json after
  }
